free_design.Place: A quiet, lamplit calligraphy room above a closed bookshop, with dark windows and ink paintings drying on a rack.
free_design.Activity: She smiles at her attempt to paint the Guan dragon in a single blue-ink stroke.
free_design.Pose: She sits upright on a low bench, her right hand holding the brush above the paper, her left palm resting on the table's edge.
free_design.Framing: A three-quarter seated portrait from slightly above the table, with both hands in view.
free_design.Outfit: An opaque oxblood wrap romper with a deep folded neckline, one sculpted shoulder strap, and offset pleated shorts.
